_note: Named caption looks. A project picks one with timeline.captions.preset; its own keys override the preset (accent = brand colour, y, keywords, emoji…). init.sh copies this file to film/lib/caption_presets.json; sync.mjs merges it. Add every format learned from a reference here (reference/CAPTIONS.md) and log it in the catalog. _meta is documentation only. An entry { alias: <name> } is an old name that points to another look (sync.mjs follows it).

_meta.useFor: premium, medical, B2B (clínicas, marcas médicas): quiet, never competes with the film's own type
talking heads, education, VO-led social ads: spoken word in the accent (set accent = brand colour; the yellow is only the no-brand default)
_meta.learnedFrom: talking-head word captions (Montserrat ExtraBold, accent keywords, black outline) + AutoCaptions-type packs

_meta.useFor: old name of karaoke (kept so older timelines and styles keep working)
energetic social ads, fast VO, offers
brand-coloured highlight: set accent/boxColor to the brand accent; boxText auto picks #111 or #fff by contrast
hooks and short punchy VO; one big word at a time
calmer read-along: sentence case, accent underline slides under the spoken word
busy or light footage where an outline isn't enough: dark words on a white card, spoken word in accent
